g.text: Numpy DDPM: noise predictor 18-128-128-128-2 (SiLU), sinusoidal time embedding, T = 100 steps, linear β from 10⁻⁴ to 0.12, 9 000 Adam steps on a ring
of eight Gaussians. 98 % of 4 000 generated samples lie within 3σ of a mode; every mode is populated (11–14 % each).
